339-677-4785-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-4785-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

971-1284-4687.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-1284-4687.description:
Activate Viridian Longbow by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

978-5256--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

678-4192-5659-5753-8095.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-4192-5659-5753-8095.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

856-5776-6351-6495.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
856-5776-6351-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

997-1981-2415-6094.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

533-2474-7839.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact.
533-2474-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 3 damage to Smaug due to City on Fire.
Smaug triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

872-4300-7857.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
872-4300-7857.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

1274-2685-3197-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2685-3197-7810.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

2921-6351-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

465-2511-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
465-2511-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

791-3693-6257-7186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
You have max speed.
791-3693-6257-7186.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-4017-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-4017-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

57-3094-3499-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3094-3499-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1409-1446-7009.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1409-1446-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
When Avatar Kuruk enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing it and Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an untapped land you control

2342-2512-3588.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate the land with Animal Boneyard attached by tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

339-677-1879-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

4613-4929-5455.description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {5}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding six {C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

539-3586-4657.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, targeting it and Magus Lucea Kane.
Magus Lucea Kane triggers, copying the Magus of the Candelabra ability, untapping Magus of the Candelabra and Magus Lucea Kane.
Holding priority, repeat as many times as desired.
Resolve a Magus of the Candelabra ability, untapping it and Magus Lucea Kane.
Activate Magus Lucea Kane and Magus of the Candelabra by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{G}.
Repeat from step 5 for each stacked Magus of the Candelabra ability.
Optionally, cast a spell with {X} in its mana cost or activate an ability with {X} in its activation cost, causing it to be copied once for each time Magus Lucea Kane was activated in step 6.
If desired, you can repeat this loop from step 1 and cost other spells or activate other abilities with {X} in their cost.

3259-3263-5953-6633.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
3259-3263-5953-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3263-5953-6633.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2921-4616-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2921-4616-6249--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1329-3169-4050-5726.notablePrerequisites:
You control a number of artifacts equal to or greater than two plus Emry's commander tax.
You have enough mana to cast Three Steps Ahead
1329-3169-4050-5726.description:
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Genesis Chamber.
Cast Emry from the command zone by paying {U}.
When Emry enters the battlefield, it and both Genesis Chambers trigger.
Resolve the Emry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
Resolve both Genesis Chamber triggers, creating two 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Choose to return Emry to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

511-817-1636-2757.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic Forest.
You control at least four creatures.
511-817-1636-2757.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, untapping the Forest.
Repeat from step 1 three additional times.
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}{G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2060-2438-2577-3602.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2060-2438-2577-3602.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1303-2232-2766-4693.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Swamp and at least one Forest that enter the battlefield untapped.
You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
1303-2232-2766-4693.description:
Activate a Swamp and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Overgrown Estate twice by sacrificing the Swamp and Forest, causing you to gain 6 life.
Cast Molderhulk by paying {B}{G}.
When Molderhulk enters the battlefield, it, Necroduality and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Molderhulk.
When the Molderhulk token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Molderhulk from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the token Molderhulk's trigger, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Swamp enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers; choose not to return anything to your hand.
Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger from step 4, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers; choose not to return anything to your hand.
Repeat.

719-1379-1558-3413.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Human" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1379-1558-3413.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Humans due to Xenograft, Xathrid Necromancer triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

628-4727-4929.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat step 1 until Cryptic Trilobite does not have any +1/+1 counters on it.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Cryptic Trilobite's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

224-654-4300-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic land.
224-654-4300-4913.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the basic land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion, causing you to draw a card and put the basic land from your hand onto the battlefield tapped, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Amulet of Vigor triggers.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

283-4050-4385.notablePrerequisites: Illusionist's Bracers attached to Sliver Queen.
283-4050-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Sliver Queen's ability.
Resolve both Sliver Queen abilities, creating two 1/1 Sliver creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Slivers, adding {2}.
Repeat.

876-1914-4939.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Burning-Tree Emissary.
Cowardice triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, adding {R}{G}.
Repeat.

3525-4474-4723.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle and Pemmin's Aura attached to Night Market Lookout.
Night Market Lookout does not have summoning sickness.
3525-4474-4723.description:
Activate Night Market Lookout by tapping it, adding {U}.
Night Market Lookout triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Night Market Lookout.
Repeat.

3617-4560.description:
Pay {2}{U/R} {U/R} to activate Soulfire Grand Master's ability.
Pay {1}{U} to cast Time Walk.
Soulfire Grand Master's ability triggers, returning Time Walk to your hand.
Pass to extra turn.
Repeat for infinite turns.

507-3031.description:
When an opponent casts a card from their hand, Possibility Storm will exile it.
They can not cast any cards from Possibility Storm because the exiled cards are not cast from their hand.
